manifest_verification: Source, review and every published partition file match the native manifest; counts independently recomputed from all dispositions.
limitations: Categories reflect recorded reason text, not a new finding that the underlying assertion is false.
A row can carry multiple concerns; exclusive categories use the first recorded leading reason. Full reasons remain available in the row-level TSV.
Counts are snapshot-bound and will change when content-bound mapping receipts are assembled.
This diagnostic is input for the root combined native structured review, not a separate native review bundle or scientific approval.
